result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible layout issues involving clipped horizontal content and the fixed bottom navigation overlapping the restaurant list.

issues.description: The category chip row is horizontally clipped on the right, leaving a partial pill visible at the edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Implement a deliberate horizontal scroll area with clear clipping behavior, or adjust spacing so the final visible chip is fully contained within the viewport.

issues.description: The horizontal 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel shows the third card cut off at the right edge, including truncated restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has intentional snap/scroll behavior and sufficient right padding, or show only complete cards within the viewport.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second popular restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its remaining content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height, or position the navigation so it does not cover restaurant cards.

issues.description: The visible second popular restaurant card is incomplete because the restaurant name and metadata are below the bottom navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Allow the page to scroll beyond the fixed navigation and verify that the complete card content remains accessible.
